title: Juicy Roasted Slovakian Vegetables
description: This salty and juicy dish features sumac as a unique twist on traditional roasted vegetables, making it both romantic and vegetarian-friendly.

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons olive oil
ingredients.notes: Extra virgin or any neutral-flavored oil can be used

ingredients.name: Salt to taste
ingredients.notes: To enhance flavors without overpowering the dish

instructions: Slice off the tops of the bell peppers and set aside. Remove seeds from inside each pepper.

In a large bowl, toss together sliced red onions, zucchini chunks, grated carrots, olive oil, sumac, salt, and any reserved pepper tops with their cut openings facing down to create an open-roasting bed for the vegetables.
Spread the vegetable mixture evenly in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil or parchment paper. This prevents sticking and easy cleanup later.
Place the baking sheet in the preheated oven and roast the vegetables for about 30 minutes, flipping them halfway through so they brown nicely from all sides.
Remove from the oven when you desire slightly crispy yet still juicy vegetables, which should be golden-brown on the outside but retain some moisture inside. Let cool slightly before serving.
